Vendored for the in-browser Ed25519 demo at /ed25519.html. Loaded as local ESM only; no CDN at runtime.

- `@noble/ed25519` 3.2.0 (MIT, Paul Miller) — https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-ed25519
- `@noble/hashes` 2.4.0 (MIT, Paul Miller) — https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes

Only the SHA-256 / SHA-512 module and its local imports are included: `sha2.js`, `_md.js`, `_u64.js`, `utils.js`.
